caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest or cabinet with four sturdy legs, a flat rectangular top surface, and a prominent front side. The front face of the chest consists of three rectangular panels across the upper section; each panel features a decorative motif with a yellowish background and an ornate red and green floral or vine-like pattern. Below the panels is a horizontal plank forming the middle section, and beneath this is a long rectangular drawer with two simple round wooden knobs placed symmetrically. The wood grain is visible throughout the piece, rendered in shades of light brown and beige. The side panel is plain, showing the direction of the wood grain. The background is a solid, uniform off-white color, with no other objects present. The composition centers the chest in the image, with slight shading beneath it to suggest depth and placement on a surface.
title: Hadley Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
